docs.summary: Fluent builder for an Origami application bar: a glass pill holding a brand mark, tags, a flexible spacer, icon action buttons and an avatar, laid out left-to-right in the order added. Construct via [`AppBar`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~AppBar), chain items, then call [`Show`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.AppBarBuilder~Show).
docs.remarks: Self-contained (Paper + Origami only). Icons are supplied as `Action<Canvas, Rect>` draw callbacks so the bar has no dependency on any particular icon set.
